name: Haran

related_people.name: Abraham
related_people.role: settled here with Terah, then left at God's call for Canaan

related_people.name: Bethuel
related_people.role: an Aramean of this region who consented to Rebekah's marriage to Isaac

related_people.name: Sarah
related_people.role: left this city with Abraham for the land God promised

description: A city in upper Mesopotamia where Abraham's family settled on their way from Ur, and where Abraham's father Terah died before Abraham continued on to Canaan at God's call (Genesis 11:31-12:5). Both Isaac's servant and, later, Jacob traveled back to Haran's vicinity to find wives among Abraham's extended family there (Genesis 24; 27:43-29:4).
